description: Machine-readable conformance fixture definitions for Writer Storage Policy capabilities (P07–P12).

capabilities.name: commit_recovery
capabilities.description: Committed containers under each policy produce valid CommitMarkers. Recovery accepts the highest valid generation regardless of writer policy.

wire_constraints.note: CommitMarker (record 0x06) is the sole acceptance authority per RC-01

capabilities.test_pattern: write+commit under each policy -> parse -> verify CommitMarker; truncate -> recover -> verify accepted generation

capabilities.name: optimization_budget_fallback
capabilities.description: When optimization budget is exceeded or exhausted, the writer falls back to a valid representation (not failure). Valid-but-less-optimized is distinguished from operation failure.
capabilities.input_description: same payload written with and without OptimizationConfiguration constraints

wire_constraints.note: Budget effects may not be observable on small payloads; test with large payloads when available

capabilities.test_pattern: write with tight search_budget -> verify commit succeeds -> verify representation is valid (even if suboptimal)

capabilities.name: cross_policy_compatibility
capabilities.description: A container written under one policy can be parsed and decoded by a reader using a different (or no) policy. Writer A -> VSN -> Reader B works.

wire_constraints.note: Cross-language: Python -> C#; Python -> TypeScript; etc.

capabilities.test_pattern: write under each policy; parse with store.open() (no storage_policy); verify content recoverable

capabilities.name: policy_not_on_wire
capabilities.description: The StoragePolicy name and its numeric value do NOT appear in any serialized container. Only ModeDeclaration (0x0701) carries the wire mode.
capabilities.test_pattern: for each policy fixture: verify no record type < 0x8000 is unexpected; verify policy name bytes absent

capabilities.name: backward_compatibility
capabilities.description: Existing library APIs (VsnStore.Create(mode), VsnStore.Open(bytes)) continue to work without any storage_policy parameter. Existing mode-based behavior is preserved.
capabilities.test_pattern: VsnStore.Create(MODE_MODERN) -> write file -> commit; VsnStore.Open(data) -> read file -> verify mode

capabilities.name: writer_options_validation
capabilities.description: WriterOptions and OptimizationConfiguration enforce validation rules: invalid budgets, memory limits, or conflicting policy+constraint pairs raise appropriate error categories.

error_categories.condition: policy + constraint disagree on wire mode
